_notes: All balancing lives here (master prompt 4.7-4.8). Sell price = baseValue x weightFactor x sizeClass.mult x market x (1 + shop sellBonus), rounded, min 1. t = (weight - min) / (max - min) of the fish's weight range.

weightRoll._notes: Suggested roll for Agent A: t = random() ^ skew; a perfect cast uses perfectSkew (heavier fish more likely).

pearls._notes: Earned only, never sold. Granted per catch by tier, plus a bonus for a trophy.

saturation._notes: Each fish of one species sold adds 1. Past freeUnits, every unit drops that species' price by dropPerUnit, down to floor. Recovers recoverPerMinute units per minute, also while away.

workers._notes: A crew member lands one fish every catchSeconds from the island's common and uncommon pool (by spawnWeight). It is sold on the spot for the pool's average baseValue x valueMult x hut rateMult x (1 + smokehouse bonus).

nets._notes: Crab pots and nets on owned land plots fill over time.

shop.name: Shop
shop.about: Sells your catch. Better counters and buyers pay more.

cooler.name: Cooler
cooler.about: Holds the fish you keep until you sell them.

workers_hut.name: Workers' hut
workers_hut.about: Room for your crew. A bigger hut fits more fishers and they work faster.

smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
smokehouse.about: Smokes part of the crew's catch so it sells for more.

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.about: Visitors pay to see every species in your logbook.

boat_dock.name: Boat dock
boat_dock.about: Your boat. A bigger dock and boat reach farther islands.

gull_spit.name: Gull Spit
gull_spit.about: A sandbar the gulls already claimed. Room for a net.

tidewrack_flats.name: Tidewrack Flats
tidewrack_flats.about: Flat sand full of things the sea forgot. Room for two more fishers and a net.

lantern_point.name: Lantern Point
lantern_point.about: A rocky point with a view of every island. Two nets fit off the rocks.

kelp_shallows.name: Kelp Shallows
kelp_shallows.about: Shallow water thick with kelp. The wraiths like it here.

offline._notes: Crew, nets and aquarium keep earning while the game is closed, up to capHours. The night watch raises the cap.

watch.name: Lamp on the pier
watch.about: Someone leaves a lamp lit so the crew keeps going.

watch.name: Night watchman
watch.about: Old Tobin's cousin keeps the crew awake.

watch.name: Lighthouse keeper
watch.about: The lighthouse keeps an eye on everything.

watch.name: Harbour bell
watch.about: Rings every hour, all night long.

test._notes: ?test=100: separate save key, x100 coins from selling and idle, extra unlock buttons in Settings.
